_doc: Rider lines this game adds to a world's own (the city export's, from the world generator's city config lines): the loaders (src/client/load.ts, src/harness/io.ts) append them to the park's lines, so NPC skaters (data/npc.json), the autopilot and ./skate lines ride them like any other. Per world: id, radius (how far off a point still counts as reaching it, metres), maxSlopeDeg, points [x, y] in site metres. EMB's two run south-east down the plaza a step beside its row of granite ledges and the fountain's rim (an NPC ollies onto the ledge or the rim as it passes); Pier 7's runs north-west between the two rows of benches. Valencia's (valencia_north) runs up Valencia St from the Mission into the park's streets: the city export's own ran through blocks the squeeze removed (docs/squeeze.md).
